title: Data, code, and Y-maze design for: Honey bees show no olfactory preference for sodium-enriched nectar
description:
Data, R analysis code, and laser-cut Y-maze design files for a behavioral study testing whether western honey bees (Apis mellifera) show an olfactory preference for sodium-enriched artificial nectar.
